local_facts.title: A city built around newer homes
local_facts.claim: A housing profile drawing on Census data lists Allen’s median year built as 2002.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A technician should read the equipment in front of them rather than assume a single era of controls, refrigerant practice or prior replacement history.

local_facts.title: Allen has a contractor process
local_facts.claim: Allen says all contractors must register annually, and its contractor form includes HVAC/Mechanical as a classification.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A repair and a full system change are different scopes. When work crosses into a replacement, the local contractor and permit process should be addressed rather than treated as an invisible swap.

local_facts.title: A documented long heat run
local_facts.claim: The National Weather Service recorded 55 days at or above 100°F in Dallas-Fort Worth during 2023, including 21 consecutive 100-degree days from July 24 through August 13.
local_facts.why_it_matters: During long heat events, weak cooling, restricted airflow and marginal electrical parts become immediately disruptive, so a repair visit should identify the source instead of relying on a temporary thermostat adjustment.

pricing.table_head: Allen and Collin County AC repair prices, job by job

anchors.label: Complete HVAC system permit, City of Allen
anchors.detail: Replacing a full system in Allen requires a $175 permit. A water heater or a standalone over the counter trade permit is $75.
anchors.source_name: City of Allen fee schedule, June 2025

anchors.label: Contractor and inspector registration, annual
anchors.detail: Every contractor pulling a permit in Allen registers with the city each year for $50. An unregistered shop cannot legally permit a changeout.
anchors.source_name: City of Allen fee schedule, June 2025

anchors.label: Inspection outside normal hours
anchors.detail: After hours inspections carry a two hour floor, and reinspections escalate at $75, then $100, then $125 for each further trip.
anchors.source_name: City of Allen fee schedule, June 2025

anchors.label: Median hourly wage, heating and air conditioning mechanics
anchors.detail: May 2025 median for the 10,910 HVAC mechanics and installers across the Dallas, Fort Worth and Arlington metro area.
anchors.source_name: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025
